test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Who taught you to play the guitar?

options.text: By whom have you been taught to play the guitar?
By whom were you taught to play the guitar by?
By whom were you taught to play the guitar?
By whom you were taught to play the guitar?

solution:
The correct answer is **'****By whom were you taught to play the guitar?'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given interrogative sentence is in Past Simple Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing an interrogative sentence in Past SimpleTense from Active voice to Passive voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence become the subject of the passive sent
